paper.title: Ground state phases of the two-dimension electron gas with a unified variational approach
paper.authors: Conor Smith, Yixiao Chen, Ryan Levy, Yubo Yang, Miguel A. Morales, Shiwei Zhang

results.system_description: 2D homogeneous electron gas, N = 56 (28 up, 28 down), r_s = 20, rectangular cell commensurate with a triangular lattice, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function ((MP)^2NQS (message-passing backflow + multiple plane waves)) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Hartree). Madelung term: included: V_E = sum v_E + (1/2) N v_M (supp. Eq. ham-ewald). Boundary: periodic, Gamma (no twist mentioned).
